title: Bundled Enemy Rebalance
doc: Supplies the verified Enemy Rebalance SQL and locale payload under BepInEx/config/ckf.hardmode.rebalances/enemy to the native mod loader. Independent of ModelRules. Disable the separate Enemy Rebalance Workshop item before using this slice. Uses the Workshop armor, roster, ceiling and surgical-correction exporter; see docs/bundled-rebalances.md.
uiDoc: Applies the bundled Enemy Rebalance package. Disable the separate Enemy Rebalance Workshop mod before enabling this switch.

fields.label: Enable Bundled Enemy Rebalance
fields.doc: BundledRebalances.Init checks this gate before reading the package and AfterList supplies its active native mod entry. Independent of ModelRules.
fields.uiDoc: Enable the bundled enemy armor, roster progression and corrections.
